title: Resource gate: judge WNS on the build floor at every corner on the best of the three directives; report the fall from the record as a warning
body:
The owner/manager ruling of 2026-10-30 (#814 thread) changes the resource gate's WNS rule for adoptions.

**Change `scripts/pp_resource_gate.py`** (and its docs: `docs/design/AREA_BUDGET.md` and `docs/integration/BUILDING.md` section 5):
- **WNS and WHS:** a route set passes when the best of the recipe's three directives meets the build floor (+0.030 ns setup, 0 ns hold) at every signoff corner. The checker takes the three routed reports, or a single one marked as the shipping selection, and names the directive it selected.
- **The fall from the record** is computed and printed as `WARNING`, with no failure.
- **Every other tolerance is unchanged:** LUT, FF, slices, RAMB and DSP.
- **The re-record** stores the selected directive's figures and names the directive.

**Self-test, with each case planted and checked for its expected verdict:**
- a route set whose best directive misses the floor at one corner fails;
- a set whose shipping directive misses the floor but whose best meets it passes, and names the best;
- a large fall passes with a WARNING;
- a resource over tolerance still fails.

**Acceptance:** the self-test passes; dev `1e80128f`'s three recorded routes from #814 round 1 pass and select ExtraPostPlacementOpt (+0.303 ns, the best worst-corner WNS of the three); the docs gates pass.

Relates to #76.
